_readme: Your test set. Edit this file; delete the keys starting with _ if you like.
documents: a short name -> path of a PDF (relative to the backend folder).
gold_pages: EVERY page that contains the answer (use: python -m evaluation.find_pages <pdf> "term").
type: factoid | table | multi-page | aggregation | unanswerable (any labels you like; results are grouped by it).
answerable: false for questions the document cannot answer (then gold_pages is not needed).
answer_contains: words/numbers a correct answer must contain (used only with --with-answers).
verified: set to true only after YOU confirmed the gold pages by reading the PDF.
The questions below are EXAMPLES with pages guessed from retrieval output. Verify every one before using the numbers.
